communication_goal: 比较实现方案，并说明当前选择的依据。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone finished educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure white background, clean consistent black line art, minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces and thin limbs, restrained polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No color, no gradients, no shading, no photographic rendering. One coherent scene, no panels. Keep all people and props in the central area approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on a 0..1000 canvas. Preserve generous empty white space at top (y<180), bottom (y>850), and sides for learning labels added later. Make the named learning props clearly recognizable and fully visible. Gestures should show a conversation. No speech balloons, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermarks, readable code, or long text; simple abstract UI marks are allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure developers stand on opposite sides of a wide whiteboard. They compare ONE diagram composed of two vertically stacked abstract implementation paths: upper path with four small connected rectangles and a tiny extra branch; lower path with two larger connected rectangles. Only arrows and blank boxes, no words, no letters, no numbering. One developer points at the upper path, the other points at the lower path. Keep both paths entirely visible together in the middle of the board, framed as a single clear diagram with enough empty space below it for a learning label. No suggestion that exact runtime speed can be seen from the drawing.
